# Appian

> > Appian is an enterprise low-code automation platform combining process mining, workflow automation, and AI to help organizations optimize business processes and drive digital transformation.

Appian provides process automation software recognized by Gartner's Magic Quadrant and Forrester, serving industries including public sector, life sciences, and manufacturing. The platform integrates Process HQ for process mining, RPA capabilities, and specialized solutions like Clause Intelligence for government contract compliance (FAR/DFARS).

## Key Topics

- Enterprise Low-Code Application Platform
- Process Mining and Process HQ
- Business Process Automation (BPA)
- Workflow Automation
- Digital Transformation
- Process Optimization and Efficiency
- Continuous Improvement
- RPA (Robotic Process Automation)
- Clause Intelligence
- Public Sector Solutions
- FAR/DFARS Compliance
- Root Cause Analysis
- Gartner Magic Quadrant
- AI and Agentic Automation
- Business Process Management (BPM)
